honesty_rule: status=done means code exists and runs in-repo. It does NOT mean production-ready, device-verified, load-tested, or live payments. Use maturity: shipped | mvp | scaffold | unverified. Never mark scaffold as if it were shipped.
instructions_for_ai: Read roadmap/STAGES.md for HOW. Read priority_order here for WHAT next. Claim one next item, implement, set honest maturity, update ROADMAP.md, push main. Current focus: S3 Playable loop so a human can play 30–60 minutes.

maturity_legend.shipped: Used end-to-end in normal play; no known major gaps for the claimed scope
maturity_legend.mvp: Works for local/dev play; balance/UX still need iteration
maturity_legend.scaffold: API/hooks/UI stubs exist; core behavior incomplete
maturity_legend.unverified: Code path exists but not proven on real device/env
